library(tidyverse)
library(stochvol)

## Load the Stage 1 results

```{r}
results_sa <- readRDS(here("data", "state_space", "local_level_sa_results.rds"))
```

## Monthly surprises from the Stage 1 model

```{r}
surprises <- results_sa |>
  mutate(surprise = pi_sa - lag(filtered)) |>
  filter(!is.na(surprise)) |>
  select(date, surprise)

summary(surprises$surprise)
```

## The largest surprises

```{r}
surprises |>
  arrange(desc(abs(surprise))) |>
  head(8)
```

```{r}
p_surprises <- ggplot(surprises, aes(date, surprise)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Surprise (annualized pp)")
p_surprises
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "stage1_surprises.png"),
       p_surprises, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## Estimate time-varying volatility of the surprises

```{r}
set.seed(2026)
sv_fit <- svsample(surprises$surprise, draws = 10000, burnin = 2000)
```

## Extract the volatility path

```{r}
vol_draws <- as.matrix(vola(sv_fit))

surprises <- surprises |>
  mutate(vol_lo  = apply(vol_draws, 2, quantile, 0.05),
         vol_med = apply(vol_draws, 2, quantile, 0.50),
         vol_hi  = apply(vol_draws, 2, quantile, 0.95))
```

## Plot and save the volatility path

```{r}
p_sv <- ggplot(surprises, aes(date)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = vol_lo, ymax = vol_hi), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = vol_med)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = sd(surprises$surprise), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Size of monthly surprises (sd, annualized pp)")
p_sv
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "sv_surprise_volatility.png"),
       p_sv, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)

saveRDS(surprises, here("data", "state_space", "sv_surprise_volatility.rds"))
```

## Core function: draw a local level path given its variances

```{r}
sample_local_level <- function(y, obs_var, step_var, init_mean, init_var, draw = TRUE) {
  n        <- length(y)
  obs_var  <- rep_len(obs_var, n)
  step_var <- rep_len(step_var, n - 1)

  H          <- bandSparse(n, k = c(0, -1), diagonals = list(rep(1, n), rep(-1, n - 1)))
  prior_prec <- Diagonal(x = 1 / c(init_var, step_var))
  obs_prec   <- Diagonal(x = 1 / obs_var)

  K <- forceSymmetric(t(H) %*% prior_prec %*% H + obs_prec)
  b <- t(H) %*% prior_prec %*% c(init_mean, rep(0, n - 1)) + obs_prec %*% y

  path_mean <- as.vector(solve(K, b))
  if (!draw) return(path_mean)
  path_mean + as.vector(solve(chol(K), rnorm(n)))
}
```

## Test: does the function reproduce the Stage 1 smoother?

```{r}
fit_sa <- StructTS(ts(results_sa$pi_sa, start = c(2010, 3), frequency = 12), type = "level")

tau_check <- sample_local_level(results_sa$pi_sa,
                                obs_var   = fit_sa$coef["epsilon"],
                                step_var  = fit_sa$coef["level"],
                                init_mean = results_sa$pi_sa[1],
                                init_var  = 1e6,
                                draw      = FALSE)

summary(abs(tau_check - results_sa$smoothed))
```

## Draw the log-volatility path given the residuals

```{r}
# Kim-Shephard-Chib (1998): 7 normals approximating the log chi-square distribution
ksc_p <- c(0.00730, 0.10556, 0.00002, 0.04395, 0.34001, 0.24566, 0.25750)
ksc_m <- c(-10.12999, -3.97281, -8.56686, 2.77786, 0.61942, 1.79518, -1.08819) - 1.2704
ksc_v <- c(5.79596, 2.61369, 5.17950, 0.16735, 0.64009, 0.34023, 1.26261)

sample_log_vol <- function(resid, h, gamma, init_mean, init_var) {
  ystar <- log(resid^2 + 1e-4)

  # for each month, pick which of the 7 normals the error most plausibly came from
  dens <- sapply(1:7, function(j) ksc_p[j] * dnorm(ystar, h + ksc_m[j], sqrt(ksc_v[j])))
  comp <- apply(dens, 1, function(d) sample(7, 1, prob = d))

  # given those picks, the log-volatility is a local level model
  sample_local_level(ystar - ksc_m[comp], obs_var = ksc_v[comp], step_var = gamma,
                     init_mean = init_mean, init_var = init_var)
}
```

## Test: volatility of Stage 1 residuals, trend held fixed

```{r}
resid_check <- results_sa$pi_sa - results_sa$smoothed
h <- rep(log(var(resid_check)), length(resid_check))
h_draws <- matrix(NA, 2000, length(h))

set.seed(2026)
for (i in 1:2000) {
  h <- sample_log_vol(resid_check, h, gamma = 0.2 / 3,
                      init_mean = log(var(resid_check)), init_var = 10)
  h_draws[i, ] <- h
}

vol_check <- apply(exp(h_draws[501:2000, ] / 2), 2, median)
plot(results_sa$date, vol_check, type = "l",
     xlab = "", ylab = "Noise volatility (sd, annualized pp)")
```

## Run the UC-SV Gibbs sampler

```{r, cache=TRUE}
y      <- results_sa$pi_sa
n      <- length(y)
gamma  <- 0.2 / 3       # Stock-Watson's 0.2 per quarter, converted to monthly
n_burn <- 5000
n_keep <- 10000
thin   <- 5          # keep every 5th draw: 50,000 rounds, 10,000 stored

# starting values: Stage 1 smoothed trend and constant volatilities
tau <- results_sa$smoothed
h   <- rep(log(var(y - tau)), n)          # noise log-variance, one per month
g   <- rep(log(var(diff(tau))), n - 1)    # trend-step log-variance, one per step
h0  <- h[1]
g0  <- g[1]

tau_draws <- matrix(NA, n_keep, n)
h_draws   <- matrix(NA, n_keep, n)
g_draws   <- matrix(NA, n_keep, n - 1)

set.seed(2026)
for (i in 1:(n_burn + n_keep * thin)) {
  tau <- sample_local_level(y, obs_var = exp(h), step_var = exp(g),
                            init_mean = y[1], init_var = 1e6)
  h   <- sample_log_vol(y - tau,   h, gamma, init_mean = h0, init_var = 10)
  g   <- sample_log_vol(diff(tau), g, gamma, init_mean = g0, init_var = 10)

    if (i > n_burn && (i - n_burn) %% thin == 0) {
    k <- (i - n_burn) / thin
    tau_draws[k, ] <- tau
    h_draws[k, ]   <- h
    g_draws[k, ]   <- g
  }
  if (i %% 10000 == 0) message("iteration ", i)
}
```

## Summarize the UC-SV draws

```{r}
q <- function(draws, p) apply(draws, 2, quantile, p)

ucsv <- tibble(
  date      = results_sa$date,
  pi_sa     = y,
  stage1    = results_sa$smoothed,
  tau_med   = q(tau_draws, 0.50),
  tau_lo    = q(tau_draws, 0.05),
  tau_hi    = q(tau_draws, 0.95),
  noise_vol = q(exp(h_draws / 2), 0.50),
  trend_vol = c(NA, q(exp(g_draws / 2), 0.50))
)

saveRDS(ucsv, here("data", "state_space", "ucsv_results.rds"))
```

## Convergence: trace plots

```{r}
idx <- function(d) which(results_sa$date == ymd(d))

trace_df <- tibble(
  iter                  = 1:n_keep,
  `trend, Jan 2018`     = tau_draws[, idx("2018-01-01")],
  `trend, Aug 2026`     = tau_draws[, n],
  `noise vol, Aug 2010` = exp(h_draws[, idx("2010-08-01")] / 2),
  `trend vol, Jan 2021` = exp(g_draws[, idx("2021-01-01") - 1] / 2)
)

p_trace <- trace_df |>
  pivot_longer(-iter) |>
  ggplot(aes(iter, value)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "MCMC iteration (after burn-in)", y = NULL)
p_trace
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "ucsv_trace_plots.png"),
       p_trace, width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

## Convergence: effective sample size

```{r}
ess <- function(draws) coda::effectiveSize(coda::mcmc(draws))

summary(ess(tau_draws))   # trend, one value per month
summary(ess(h_draws))     # noise log-volatility
summary(ess(g_draws))     # trend log-volatility
```

## UC-SV sampler as a reusable function

```{r}
run_ucsv <- function(y, tau_start, gamma, n_burn = 5000, n_keep = 10000, thin = 5, seed = 2026) {
  n   <- length(y)
  tau <- tau_start
  h   <- rep(log(var(y - tau)), n)
  g   <- rep(log(var(diff(tau))), n - 1)
  h0  <- h[1]
  g0  <- g[1]

  tau_draws <- matrix(NA, n_keep, n)
  h_draws   <- matrix(NA, n_keep, n)
  g_draws   <- matrix(NA, n_keep, n - 1)

  set.seed(seed)
  for (i in 1:(n_burn + n_keep * thin)) {
    tau <- sample_local_level(y, obs_var = exp(h), step_var = exp(g),
                              init_mean = y[1], init_var = 1e6)
    h   <- sample_log_vol(y - tau,   h, gamma, init_mean = h0, init_var = 10)
    g   <- sample_log_vol(diff(tau), g, gamma, init_mean = g0, init_var = 10)

    if (i > n_burn && (i - n_burn) %% thin == 0) {
      k <- (i - n_burn) / thin
      tau_draws[k, ] <- tau
      h_draws[k, ]   <- h
      g_draws[k, ]   <- g
    }
    if (i %% 10000 == 0) message("iteration ", i)
  }

  list(tau = tau_draws, h = h_draws, g = g_draws)
}
```

## Sensitivity: rerun UC-SV with gamma = 0.2

```{r}
ucsv_fast <- run_ucsv(y, tau_start = results_sa$smoothed, gamma = 0.2)

ucsv_g02 <- tibble(
  date         = results_sa$date,
  tau_med      = q(ucsv_fast$tau, 0.50),
  noise_vol    = q(exp(ucsv_fast$h / 2), 0.50),
  trend_vol    = c(NA, q(exp(ucsv_fast$g / 2), 0.50)),
  trend_vol_lo = c(NA, q(exp(ucsv_fast$g / 2), 0.05)),
  trend_vol_hi = c(NA, q(exp(ucsv_fast$g / 2), 0.95))
)
saveRDS(ucsv_g02, here("data", "state_space", "ucsv_results_gamma02.rds"))

summary(ess(ucsv_fast$g))
```

## Real-time UC-SV trend: particle filter

```{r}
ucsv_filter <- function(y, gamma, h_init, g_init, init_var = 10,
                        n_particles = 20000, seed = 2026) {
  set.seed(seed)
  n <- length(y); N <- n_particles

  h <- rnorm(N, h_init, sqrt(init_var))   # noise log-variance, per world
  g <- rnorm(N, g_init, sqrt(init_var))   # trend-step log-variance, per world
  m <- rep(y[1], N)                       # each world's trend estimate
  P <- rep(1e6, N)                        # each world's uncertainty about it

  out <- tibble(tau_med = NA_real_, tau_lo = NA_real_, tau_hi = NA_real_,
                noise_vol = NA_real_, trend_vol = NA_real_, .rows = n)

  for (t in 1:n) {
    # 1. move: volatilities drift, trend uncertainty grows by one step
    if (t > 1) {
      if (t > 2) g <- g + rnorm(N, 0, sqrt(gamma))
      h <- h + rnorm(N, 0, sqrt(gamma))
      P <- P + exp(g)
    }
    # 2. predict and score: how likely was this month's inflation in each world?
    S    <- P + exp(h)
    logw <- dnorm(y[t], m, sqrt(S), log = TRUE)
    w    <- exp(logw - max(logw)); w <- w / sum(w)

    # 3. update: ordinary Kalman filter step within each world
    K <- P / S
    m <- m + K * (y[t] - m)
    P <- (1 - K) * P

    # 4. resample: keep good worlds, drop poor ones
    idx <- sample.int(N, N, replace = TRUE, prob = w)
    h <- h[idx]; g <- g[idx]; m <- m[idx]; P <- P[idx]

    tau_samples <- rnorm(N, m, sqrt(P))
    out$tau_med[t]   <- median(tau_samples)
    out$tau_lo[t]    <- quantile(tau_samples, 0.05)
    out$tau_hi[t]    <- quantile(tau_samples, 0.95)
    out$noise_vol[t] <- median(exp(h / 2))
    out$trend_vol[t] <- if (t > 1) median(exp(g / 2)) else NA
  }
  out
}
```

## Run the real-time filter and check it against the MCMC

```{r}
ucsv_rt <- ucsv_filter(y, gamma = 0.2 / 3,
                       h_init = log(var(y - results_sa$smoothed)),
                       g_init = log(var(diff(results_sa$smoothed)))) |>
  mutate(date = results_sa$date, .before = 1)

saveRDS(ucsv_rt, here("data", "state_space", "ucsv_realtime.rds"))

# final month: real-time and full-sample use the same data, so they should agree
c(filter_final = tail(ucsv_rt$tau_med, 1), mcmc_final = tail(ucsv$tau_med, 1))
```

## Compare real-time UC-SV with Stage 1, headline and Mongolbank core

```{r}
comparison <- readRDS(here("data", "state_space", "comparison_yoy.rds"))

ucsv_rt_yoy <- ucsv_rt |>
  transmute(date,
            ucsv_yoy = 100 * (exp(zoo::rollmeanr(tau_med, 12, fill = NA) / 100) - 1))

comparison_ucsv <- comparison |>
  rename(stage1_yoy = trend_yoy) |>
  left_join(ucsv_rt_yoy, by = "date")

p_compare_ucsv <- comparison_ucsv |>
  pivot_longer(-date) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = name)) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Year-over-year inflation (%)", colour = NULL)
p_compare_ucsv
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "ucsv_vs_stage1_headline_core.png"),
       p_compare_ucsv, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)

saveRDS(comparison_ucsv, here("data", "state_space", "comparison_yoy_ucsv.rds"))

comparison_ucsv |> filter(date == max(date))
```
